rules.strong: Same arXiv base ID or explicit DOI; version suffix retained separately.
rules.weak: NFKC/casefold/alphanumeric normalized exact title, unless both groups carry conflicting same-type identifiers.
rules.not_merged: Fuzzy title matches; different IDs without a shared identity key.
rules.review_status: Only records in review evidence files count; curated queue metadata never adds reads.
rules.date_scope: Index inclusion does not establish first publication inside window; venue dates, preprints and revisions remain distinct.
rules.snapshot_policy: Original byte-identical hash-verified caches; no network refresh.
